-- w/l/go.mod --
module example.com/l

go 1.27

-- w/l/a/a.lgo --
package a

type User struct {
	Name string
}

type T struct {
	X int
}

func F() *User? {
	return nil
}

type Box struct {
	P *T?
}

func (b *Box) Set(u *User) string {
	return u.Name
}

func G(u *User) string {
	return u.Name
}

func H() []int? {
	return nil
}

func I() int? {
	return 7
}

func N() (int?)? {
	var i int? = 7
	return i
}

func PickAny() any? {
	return nil
}

func PickError() error? {
	return nil
}

func PickMap() map[string]int? {
	return nil
}

func PickFunc() (func() int)? {
	return nil
}

func PickChan() chan int? {
	return nil
}

type MapOrStr interface {
	map[string]int | string
}

func PickMapUnion() MapOrStr? {
	return nil
}

type Speaker interface {
	const Speak() string
}

type Person struct {
	Name string
}

func (p Person) Speak() string {
	return p.Name
}

-- w/g/go.mod --
module example.com/g

go 1.27

-- w/g/q/q.go --
package q

import (
	"fmt"
	"strings"

	"example.com/l/a"
	"logos/rt"
)

var _ func() *a.User = a.F
var _ func(*a.User) string = a.G
var _ func() rt.Option[[]int] = a.H
var _ func() rt.Option[int] = a.I
var _ func() rt.Option[rt.Option[int]] = a.N
var _ func() rt.Option[any] = a.PickAny
var _ func() rt.Option[error] = a.PickError
var _ func() rt.Option[map[string]int] = a.PickMap
var _ func() rt.Option[func() int] = a.PickFunc
var _ func() rt.Option[chan int] = a.PickChan
var _ func() rt.Option[a.MapOrStr] = a.PickMapUnion
var _ *a.T = a.Box{}.P
var _ a.Speaker = a.Person{}

func SpeakUp() string {
	var s a.Speaker = a.Person{Name: "gadget"}
	return s.Speak()
}

func Run() string {
	if a.F() != nil {
		return "F-non-nil"
	}
	h := a.H()
	if h.Present {
		return "F-nil H-present"
	}
	i := a.I()
	if !i.Present || i.Value != 7 {
		return "F-nil H-none I-bad"
	}
	n := a.N()
	if !n.Present || !n.Value.Present || n.Value.Value != 7 {
		return "F-nil H-none I-seven N-bad"
	}
	got := a.G(&a.User{Name: "gadget"})
	out := "F-nil H-none I-seven G-ok: " + got

	func() {
		defer func() {
			if r := recover(); r != nil {
				out += " defer-ok: " + fmt.Sprint(r)
			}
		}()
		defer a.G(nil)
	}()

	func() {
		defer func() {
			if r := recover(); r != nil {
				out += " method-ok: " + fmt.Sprint(r)
			}
		}()
		b := &a.Box{}
		_ = b.Set(nil)
	}()

	func() {
		defer func() {
			if r := recover(); r != nil {
				msg := fmt.Sprint(r)
				if strings.Contains(msg, "logos: nil from Go value") {
					out += " func-value-CHECKED"
				} else {
					out += " func-value-ok"
				}
			}
		}()
		f := a.G
		_ = f(nil)
		out += " func-value-no-panic"
	}()

	out += " speak-ok: " + SpeakUp()

	return out
}

func DirectMsg() string {
	var msg string
	func() {
		defer func() {
			if r := recover(); r != nil {
				msg = fmt.Sprint(r)
			}
		}()
		_ = a.G(nil)
	}()
	return msg
}

-- w/g/cmd/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/g/q"
)

func main() {
	fmt.Println(q.Run())
	fmt.Println("direct-ok: " + q.DirectMsg())
}

	time.Sleep(time.Second)
}

-- e/lp/go.mod --
module example.com/lp

go 1.27

-- e/lp/p/p.lgo --
package p

type User struct {
	Name string
}

func G(u *User) string {
	return u.Name
}

func Msg() string {
	return "dep-ok"
}

type Speaker interface {
	const Speak() string
}

type Person struct {
	Name string
}

func (p Person) Speak() string {
	return p.Name
}

func Find(ok bool) *User? {
	if ok {
		return &User{Name: "found"}
	}
	return nil
}

type Left struct {
	N int
}

func (l Left) Name() string { return "left" }

type Right struct {
	S string
}

func (r Right) Name() string { return "right" }

type Choice interface {
	Left | Right
	Name() string
}

func Pick(i int) Choice? {
	if i == 0 {
		var c Choice = Left{N: 7}
		return c
	}
	if i == 1 {
		var c Choice = Right{S: "r"}
		return c
	}
	return nil
}

func Describe(c Choice?) string {
	if c != nil {
		return c.Name()
	}
	return "absent"
}

-- e/gapp/go.mod --
module example.com/gapp

go 1.27

require example.com/lp v1.2.3

replace example.com/lp v1.2.3 => ../lp

-- e/gapp/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"strings"

	"example.com/lp/p"
)

var _ func(bool) *p.User = p.Find
var _ func(int) p.Choice = p.Pick
var _ func(p.Choice) string = p.Describe

func pointerOption() {
	var found *p.User = p.Find(true)
	var absent *p.User = p.Find(false)
	fmt.Println("pointer-option:", found.Name, absent == nil)
}

func unionOption() {
	var absent p.Choice = p.Pick(2)
	var left p.Choice = p.Pick(0)
	var right p.Choice = p.Pick(1)
	l, leftOK := left.(p.Left)
	r, rightOK := right.(p.Right)
	fmt.Println("union-option:", absent == nil, leftOK, l.N, rightOK, r.S)
	fmt.Println("union-param:", p.Describe(nil), p.Describe(p.Right{S: "x"}), p.Describe(left))
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println(p.Msg())
	pointerOption()
	unionOption()
	func() {
		defer func() {
			if r := recover(); r != nil {
				if strings.Contains(fmt.Sprint(r), "logos: nil from Go value") {
					fmt.Println("eject-check: logos")
				} else {
					fmt.Println("eject-check: no-logos")
				}
			}
		}()
		_ = p.G(nil)
		fmt.Println("eject-check: no-panic")
	}()
}
